title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs Security Update
description: A heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability exists in the HDF5 library used in Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs. The flaw occurs during parsing of object header messages, where insufficient boundary checks allow message bodies to offset beyond checked boundaries. This can lead to application crashes (denial of service) or limited disclosure of process memory when opening specially crafted HDF5 files. Red Hat has released updated RPM packages to address this issue.
